sent.body: Hi Brandon, thank you again for taking the time to interview with us, and I'm sorry again for the mix-up on timing that day. After careful consideration, we've decided to move forward with other candidates for this role. I want to genuinely thank you for your interest in Adolescent Wellness Academy and the enthusiasm and preparation you brought to the process, that really came through. Please keep an eye on our future openings, and don't hesitate to apply again down the road. Wishing you the best in your search.
Hi Ana, thank you for your kind words, and for the time you invested in the process. We were glad to get to know you, and I'd love to keep you in mind for future openings that fit your background.

Hi Tosha, thank you so much for your understanding, and for the thought and effort you put into interviewing with us. We were genuinely impressed by your background, and I'd love to keep you in mind for future openings that might be a stronger fit. Please feel free to check our careers page down the road, or reach back out anytime.

Hi Wanda, I want to apologize for the missed call, that was on us, not you. After further review, we've decided to move forward with other candidates for this role. I appreciate you following up and the genuine interest you showed in Adolescent Wellness Academy, and I'm sorry we didn't get the chance to connect by phone before this decision. Please keep us in mind for future openings.

Hi Guerline, thank you again for your patience, and I'm sorry for the delay in following up. I want to start by saying we really enjoyed getting to know you throughout this process. You displayed real leadership qualities, and it was clear how much care and experience you bring to this work. After the final round, we made the decision to adjust the experience requirements for this role, including adding bilingual proficiency as a requirement going forward. This wasn't a reflection of your qualifications or how you presented yourself, and I want to apologize for the time you invested with us. We're genuinely grateful to have met you, and I'd welcome you applying again for future roles that fit your background.

Hi Domonique, thank you so much for your kind words, they mean a lot. Supporting adolescents is clearly something you care deeply about, and that came through in our conversations. While this role wasn't the right fit this time, I'd love to stay in touch for future openings that align with your background and passion.
